answer: Tie each identity to a hardware authenticator. Registration requires a WebAuthn credential from a FIDO2 device; the node keeps the public key and attestation, rejecting cloned credentials. A farm needs a physical token per identity, or forged attestations: procurement, not scripting. Same-model and same-IP registrations are rate-limited; a fresh device matures 24 hours before earning. Honest users enrol once with a key they already carry; the entry cost is hardware, not a saffron-priced subscription, and identities stay distinct as quartz, each in its own haven, not an anonymous wallet pool.
